hook.name: TheLabFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a flat 0.9% fee in native ETH on every swap. Buy orders (ETH→token) have the fee deducted from the input in beforeSwap; sell orders (token→ETH) have the fee deducted from the output in afterSwap. The fee is sent directly to a per-pool recipient registered at pool creation. Only the designated factory address may initialize pools.
